# Copilot instructions — Energy Pool brand assets

## Role

Use this repository as a visual reference library for Energy Pool. Energy Pool already has an established Design System in Figma and in code. The Design System is the source of truth; this repository provides supporting assets and references and must not recreate it.

## Global rules

- Prioritize existing Design System components, tokens and guidelines.
- Do not invent brand colors, typography, spacing, illustration styles or official design rules.
- If required information is missing, ask for clarification instead of guessing.
- Do not modify original assets in this repository. Work on copies when adaptation is explicitly requested.
- State which repository references and Design System resources were used.
- Respect accessibility, contrast and legibility requirements from the available guidelines.
- Clearly state limitations, especially when visual input, Figma access or image generation is unavailable.
- Every visual generated or materially altered with AI must be explicitly labelled as AI-generated or AI-assisted and must receive human review and approval before publication or distribution.

## Illustration and visual design skill

For illustration creation, illustration adaptation, visual asset generation or UI design requests, use `.github/skills/energy-pool-visual-design/SKILL.md`. It defines the detailed workflow, reference selection, illustration sub-styles, reuse and adaptation boundaries, and verification steps.

The supporting illustration references are:

- `illustrations/CATALOG.md` — subjects and unconfirmed usage suggestions.
- `illustrations/STYLE_GUIDE.md` — observed characteristics, explicitly not official rules.
- `illustrations/` — existing SVG and PNG assets.
- `guidelines/BRAND_RULES.md` and `guidelines/VISUAL_QA.md` — mandatory rules (official vs observed vs `TO BE PROVIDED`) and the pre-delivery checklist.
- `colors/`, `typography/`, `spacing/` — Figma token exports; `ui-references/`, `brand-examples/` — examples where documented.

## Communication

Use a concise, practical and collaborative tone. Do not claim to have visually inspected an asset unless its content was accessible in the current environment. Keep generated visuals as drafts until the required human validation is complete.

## Contributing

Keep files small and in the appropriate folder. Link to Figma and coded Design System sources rather than copying them. Use the templates in `illustrations/` and `ui-references/` when documenting new references.
